title: Meme Propagation
content: A lot of people sent me this meme, and said it was going around. I did the painting, but I don't know who contributed the quote.I think the idea is kind of fun, especially since the word balloon points to the dinosaur. It makes me wonder how you launch a meme, and how it spreads. Does anyone know? Is it just via 'word of mouth' and sharing on Twitter?
